thread.text:
With @Google:

Google AI Mode now lets you track flight prices, see points rates, and book hotels in one conversation.

Convenient? Yes. But when search, recommendations, and transactions merge, can users tell what is best for them—and what is best for Google?
thread.alt_text: Overview of Google AI Mode travel features and the trust question

thread.text:
The official blog shows price tracking, points display, and hotel booking inside AI Mode.

But it never explains how commercial rankings or sponsored content are labeled.

That's a trust gap when money is involved.
thread.alt_text: Screenshot of Google AI Mode travel features from the official blog

thread.text:
The real shift isn't a better travel search.

It's Google moving transactions into the conversation, capturing intent-to-payment in one flow.

For product folks: convenience wins early, but transparency decides long-term trust.

xiaohongshu.title: Google把旅行预订塞进AI Mode
xiaohongshu.body:
Google 在 AI Mode 里加入了航班价格追踪、积分显示和酒店预订，把原本要开十几个标签页的旅行规划，压缩成一段对话。

我看到官方博客介绍，用户可以直接在对话里设置价格提醒、查看积分成本，甚至用 Google Pay 完成酒店预订。这确实省事，但真正让我在意的是：搜索、推荐和交易第一次靠得这么近，用户怎么判断哪个结果是真正适合自己的，哪个是商业合作？

官方资料没有说明如何标注商业排序或赞助内容。当推荐和交易混在一起，用户可能分不清自然推荐和广告。酒店预订目前也只在美国英语环境推出，合作伙伴有限。

从产品经理的角度，这种设计早期可以靠便利性吸引用户，但长期必须解决“平台是否在替我做决定”的疑虑。便利性提升的同时，信任设计不能缺席。

你觉得 AI 搜索里直接完成交易，是效率革命还是信任陷阱？
